_readme: Guest reviews shown on the Story and Visit pages. status: "live" shows the reviews below; "hidden" leaves the section out; "sample" renders placeholders with visible Sample tags (preview only). Reviews are copied word for word from the café's Google listing; names are shortened to first name + last initial, and "Google reviewer" is used where the screenshot did not show a name. rating/count/asOf come from the Google listing; update them together. Run npm run build after editing.

reviews.name: Anaya K.
reviews.text:
The ambience here is really amazing, and I absolutely love this place. I tried the Alfredo Pasta, Aglio Olio Pasta, Burrata Caprese, Croissant Sandwich, Cappuccino, Ice Cream, Kesar Pista Faluda, and Hazelnut Shake. Every dish was delicious and well-prepared.

A special mention to Anaya and Avijit for their excellent service. They are very polite, friendly, and make guests feel welcome. Their hospitality made the experience even better. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.name: Niji T.
reviews.text:

Foods were so so tasty.
Overall perfect
Highlyyyyy  recommended. 🫶🫶🫶

reviews.name: Shruti K.
reviews.text: New Gelato place in town. Awesome flavours really liked tiramisu and a tangy refreshing limecello. Nice Insta worthy place do visit!

reviews.name: Anil K.
reviews.text: This joint is newly opened in wanorie, Pune n its speciality is Italian cuisine.  The staff has been very polite n helpful, additional marks to Avijit for helping us with menu selection n everything. Best wishes to entire Krishna Heaven team!!

reviews.name: Google reviewer
reviews.text: Excellent place with a wonderful ambiance and a wide variety of delicious food options. The taste is outstanding, and the overall atmosphere makes the experience even more enjoyable. The staff is extremely helpful, friendly, and supportive. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food and excellent service.

reviews.name: Google reviewer
reviews.text: Very nice staff and very nice service, they immediately changed my watermelon juice wen it was not good, and quality and service matters for them... Keep up the good work going

summary: Guests on Google mention the fresh gelato and unusual flavours, vegetarian food from pizzas to pasta, a clean and welcoming space that suits families (and photos), and polite, helpful staff.
